blind.description: A stylized metal epergne or tiered fruit centerpiece standing on a fluted central pedestal base. It features a large elevated central dish filled with assorted fruit—red apples, yellow pears, an orange, and green grape clusters with green leaves—along with smaller auxiliary dishes branching off the sides on curved arms holding small snacks or fruits. All geometry is solid, continuous, and stylized with clean hand-painted or low-poly textures.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a cluster of brightly colored fruit (yellow pears, red apples, an orange, and green grapes) inside a circular central bowl, flanked by smaller round side bowls extending out at three points.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 to 1/5 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 1 to 1.3 feet tall) and about 1 to 1.3 feet wide across the side bowls.
